title: Lesson 10 - Data Cloud Setup Home, Data Spaces, and Organization-Wide Settings
description: Configure Data 360 permissions, permission sets, and organization-wide settings, focused on provisioning, the Data Cloud Setup areas, data space creation and limits, and org-wide settings such as the Feature Manager.

questions.question: A business wants to segregate two brands' data inside one Data 360 instance but holds only the standard Data Cloud license. What is true?
options: The standard license includes unlimited data spaces
The standard license includes only the default data space, and more require the Data Spaces add-on
Data spaces are unnecessary because each brand is a separate org
The data space prefix can be changed at any time
questions.explanation: Standard Data Cloud and Customer Data Platform licenses include only the default data space, so additional spaces need the Data Spaces add-on license. The distractor about separate orgs is wrong because a data space is a partition inside one Data 360 instance, not a distinct tenant.

questions.question: An admin created a data space with prefix BR1 and now wants to rename it to BR2. What is the correct statement?
options: Rename it in Data Spaces and the change propagates automatically
The prefix cannot be changed after save because it is part of object API names
Delete and recreate the space with no impact on dependent objects
Change the prefix in the Feature Manager
questions.explanation: The prefix is fixed at save because it is embedded in API names of objects that live in multiple data spaces. Deleting and recreating is the strongest distractor and is wrong because objects already depend on the space, which blocks deletion.

questions.question: A team cannot see a specific connector as a source option in the connection wizard, though other connectors work. What should the admin check first?
options: Whether the connector feature is enabled in the Feature Manager
questions.explanation: Beta and AI connectors must be enabled in the Feature Manager before their type appears in the connection wizard. Changing the profile is the strongest distractor and is wrong because the wizard content is governed by org feature enablement, not by the user's profile.
